# Support

For usage questions and design ideas, use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tristanjcb/DockerScope/discussions).
For reproducible bugs and feature requests, use the issue forms.
For vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

This is a volunteer project with no guaranteed response time or commercial support.
Support the project by reproducing bugs, reviewing PRs, improving documentation and
sharing feedback. Monetary sponsorship has not been configured; no donation account
is implied by the repository funding link.
